contentHtml:
Hyderabad: The United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) has classified the inspection outcome at Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited's FTO-SEZ Process Unit-02 in Srikakulam, Andhra Pradesh, as Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) and officially closed the inspection.

The update follows the company’s earlier intimation dated July 29, 2026, regarding a Pre-Approval Inspection (PAI) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) inspection conducted by the USFDA at its FTO-SEZ Process Unit-02 in Srikakulam, Andhra Pradesh.

Also Read: Warangal Super Speciality Hospital to start OP Services from October 20

In its communication dated October 28, 2026, Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories stated that the USFDA had concluded the inspection under 21 CFR 20.64(d)(3). The inspection outcome was classified as Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI).
